metas.name: S2 E3 · Treehouse of Horror
metas.description: The Simpson kids hide in the family treehouse and tell each other spooky stories. The first regards haunted houses, the second introduces Kang and Kodos for the first time in an alien abduction, and the third is a Simpson-adapted retelling of The Raven.

metas.name: S3 E7 · Treehouse of Horror II
metas.description: Maggie uses one of three wishes; a mind-reading Bart rules Springfield; Homer donates his brain to Mr. Burns' science project.

metas.name: S4 E5 · Treehouse of Horror III
metas.description: A Halloween trilogy includes a murderous Krusty doll; a "King Kong" parody; an invasion of zombies unleashed by Bart's incantation.

metas.name: S5 E5 · Treehouse of Horror IV
metas.description: Homer sells his soul; Vampire Burns invites the Simpsons for dinner; Bart sees a gremlin damaging his school bus.

metas.name: S6 E6 · Treehouse of Horror V
metas.description: Lack of beer and cable TV make Homer a crazed killer; the present is altered by a time-traveling Homer; and Principal Skinner turns detention students into food.

metas.name: S7 E6 · Treehouse of Horror VI
metas.description: In "Attack of the 50 Foot Eyesores," strange atmospheric conditions bring giant advertising statues to life. metas.name: S8 E1 · Treehouse of Horror VII
metas.description: A Halloween trilogy. This time, Bart meets his "pure evil" Siamese twin; Lisa's science project attacks Bart; aliens Kang and Kodos invade as Clinton and Dole's replicas just before the 1996 Presidential election.

metas.name: S9 E4 · Treehouse of Horror VIII
metas.description: In “The Homega Man,” Homer faces a post-apocalyptic Springfield. Next, Bart attempts to become Superfly in "Fly vs. Fly." In “Easy-Bake Coven,” amidst a witch hunt in 1649, Marge and her sisters invent trick-or-treating.

metas.name: S10 E4 · Treehouse of Horror IX
metas.description: In "Hell Toupée," Snake is sent to the electric chair, and his hair is transplanted onto Homer. metas.name: S11 E4 · Treehouse of Horror X
metas.description: In "I Know What You Diddily-Iddly-Did" the Simpsons fear they have killed Ned Flanders. "Desperately Xeeking Xena" satirizes superheroes of yore with "Stretch Dude" Bart and "Clobber Girl" Lisa. And "Life's A Glitch, Then You Die" depicts the upcoming horror of Y2K.

metas.name: S12 E1 · Treehouse of Horror XI
metas.description: This year's Halloween story sees The Simpsons as "The Munsters" (with everyone except Lisa getting killed), Homer as a wandering spirit on the hunt for a good deed in "G-G-Ghost D-D-Dad," Bart and Lisa as peasants in a fairy tale forest in "Scary Tales Can Come True," and Lisa in

metas.name: S13 E1 · Treehouse of Horror XII
metas.description:
In the twelfth Treehouse of Horror episode:

metas.description:
The 13th Treehouse of Horror episode, consisting of three self-contained segments.

Send in the Clones – Homer buys a hammock that can produce clones of himself. He creates numerous clones to help him around the house, but they soon overrun Springfield.

metas.name: S16 E1 · Treehouse of Horror XV
metas.description: Ned Flanders' head injury gives him the power to predict others' deaths, Bart and Lisa play detective when a string of Victorian-era prostitutes are murdered by Jack the Ripper, and the Simpsons go on a fantastic voyage inside Mr. Burns' body to save Maggie.

metas.name: S17 E4 · Treehouse of Horror XVI
metas.description: Bart ends up in a coma after attempting to jump from the roof to the swimming pool at Spinster Arms Apartments, while attending a hunting party at Burns Manor, Homer panics and believes the prey is the hunting party, and after losing a Halloween costume contest to Dr Hibbert as D

metas.name: S18 E4 · Treehouse of Horror XVII
metas.description: The 17th annual Halloween trilogy. Included: "Married to the Blob," in which a meteor turns Homer into a monster; "You Gotta Know When to Golem," about a monster from Jewish folklore; and "The Day the Earth Looked Stupid," about an alien invasion.

metas.name: S19 E5 · Treehouse of Horror XVIII
metas.description: The series' 18th Halloween show features three vignettes that parody movies: one that spoofs "Mr. & Mrs. Smith"; one that sends up "E.T."; and one that parodies "Se7en."

metas.name: S20 E4 · Treehouse of Horror XIX
metas.description: Springfield is the setting for parodies of Charlie Brown, It's the Great Pumpkin and Michael Bay's Transformers as Homer's vote on election day is misread by a renegade machine.

metas.name: S21 E4 · Treehouse of Horror XX
metas.description: Dial "M" for Murder or Press "#" to Return to Main Menu- Lisa is forced into a Hitchcockian murder scheme by Bart. Don't Have a Cow, Mankind- Springfield is once again overrun by zombies, thanks to Krusty Burger's latest sandwich. There's No Business Like Moe Business- In a Sween

metas.name: S22 E4 · Treehouse of Horror XXI
metas.description: Worried about the effects of violent video games, Marge encourages Bart and Milhouse to play board games; Lisa becomes smitten with a new student, a vampire; while on a second honeymoon, Homer and Marge rescue a castaway who escaped from his ship.

metas.name: S23 E3 · Treehouse of Horror XXII
metas.description: A boulder traps Homer's arm when he takes a drive through a canyon; a spider bite paralyzes Homer; Flanders becomes a vigilante by night; Bart and Milhouse travel to a distant planet to obtain an extract.

metas.name: S24 E2 · Treehouse of Horror XXIII
metas.description: A black hole threatens to swallow Springfield, Homer tries to find the source of paranormal activity, and a "Back to the Future" parody in which Bart keeps Marge from marrying Homer.

metas.name: S25 E2 · Treehouse of Horror XXIV
metas.description: The scariest Simpsons Halloween show yet, featuring an opening by Guillermo Del Toro.

metas.name: S26 E4 · Treehouse of Horror XXV
metas.description: In a Halloween-theme episode Bart reads Aramaic symbols from the bottom of his desk and he and Lisa are transported to an alternate world filled with demons. Also, Moe organizes a "Clockwork Orange"-ish gang in which member Dum (Homer) falls for a young lady (Marge) who wants him

metas.name: S27 E5 · Treehouse of Horror XXVI
metas.description: In the annual fright fest Halloween episode, Sideshow Bob finally kills Bart, only to reanimate him; Homer wakes up with short-term memory loss; and Lisa, Bart, and Milhouse get super powers from radiation.

metas.name: S28 E4 · Treehouse of Horror XXVII
metas.description: Better late than never, The Hunger Games come to Springfield!

metas.name: S29 E4 · Treehouse of Horror XXVIII
metas.description: Maggie becomes possessed by an ancient demon, Lisa discovers a creepy/perfect version of her family in an alternate universe and Homer cannibalizes himself.

metas.name: S30 E4 · Treehouse of Horror XXIX
metas.description: Homer wins an oyster-eating contest against the mythical Cthulhu, Springfield is overrun by plant body-snatchers, Lisa finally snaps and Mr. Burns opens a retirement home with some Jurassic upgrades.

metas.name: S31 E4 · Treehouse of Horror XXX
metas.description: The 666th episode of the Simpsons parodies the Omen and Stranger Things, not to mention a little Crazy Rich Aliens.

metas.name: S32 E4 · Treehouse of Horror XXXI
metas.description: The 31st annual Simpsons Halloween special includes a frightening look at the 2020 election, parodies of Toy Story and Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse and a 9th birthday Lisa just can't get over.

metas.name: S33 E3 · Treehouse of Horror XXXII
metas.description: The 32nd annual Simpsons Halloween special includes a spoof of "Parasite" and a segment where Bambi gets his revenge.

metas.name: S34 E6 · Treehouse of Horror XXXIII
metas.description: In a book-themed trilogy, Marge's resentment takes monstrous form, Lisa tries to save the planet through murder and Homer learns he's not the man he thought he was.

metas.name: S35 E5 · Treehouse of Horror XXXIV
metas.description: After Bart is turned into an NFT, Marge fights though the blockchain to rescue her son. To track down a gruesome serial killer, Lisa turns to a murderer from her past. An outbreak transforms Springfielders into a plague of lazy, beer-loving oafs.

metas.name: S36 E5 · Treehouse of Horror XXXV
metas.description: Giant monsters created by political rage threaten to tear the town apart, a Victorian Mr. Burns is jump-scared on Thanksgiving by the ghosts of his abused workers, and Homer bonds with a pair of extra-terrestrial jeans in an unforgettable stop-motion adventure that can only be ca

metas.name: S36 E7 · Treehouse of Horror Presents: Simpsons Wicked This Way Comes
metas.description: A tattooed man at a mysterious night circus transports Lisa into three strange stories from the innocent 1950s, the chilling retro-present, and a brutalist future where prestige TV rules the world.

metas.name: S37 E3 · Treehouse of Horror XXXVI
metas.description: Springfield is threatened by a mysterious killer monster emerging from the sewers, Krusty welcomes a demonic guest to his Halloween special, and the action moves a thousand years into the future in a post-apocalyptic, plastic version of the city.

metas.name: S38 E3 · Treehouse of Horror Presents: The Revengening
metas.description: All hell breaks loose on Halloween when a killer comes to Springfield and hacks their way through town. No Simpson is safe from... THE REVENGENING!

metas.name: S38 E4 · Treehouse of Horror XXXVII
metas.description: In this year's extra-scary, ultra-spooky Treehouse of Horror, Marge gets a horrifying new perspective on marriage; Bart and Santa's Little Helper embark on a bone-chilling adventure; and Homer takes a driving lesson.
